note: The fixture pair for retry-policy (L06 in fixtures/PLAN.md), hand-written retry loops with axios and fetch, under Fastify form, scanned with retry-policy alone. Written by hand: each planted defect is fixed in place in the clean twin, line for line, and the twins differ in nothing else. A finding catches a defect when its check matches and its locations name the defect's file, line, column and symbol (every place, when the defect lists several), with the defect's severity. Decoys are in both twins; reporting one is a false positive. Paths are relative to each twin. Nothing here is installed or run.
